title: Elenchos configuration
description: Configuration of a consumer of the gate, written in TOML: its checks, its severity policy and its suppressions file. Relative paths resolve against the root.

version.description: Version of the configuration format; version 2 adds `renames` and the `scope` of a check.

root.description: Root of the consumer, relative to the directory of the configuration file; it contains the configuration file, and the commands run in it.

output.description: Path where the merged SARIF log is written.

suppressions.description: Path of the suppressions file, under the root; absent when the consumer tolerates no finding.

policy.description: Levels that block, by default and for each rule.

block.description: Levels that block when neither the rule nor the check declares its own.

rules.description: Levels that block for one rule, keyed by `tool|ruleId`; they take precedence over the levels of the check and the default.

checks.description: Declared checks, keyed by name, run in the order of the file.

renames.description: Maps applied to stored suppressions before they are matched (version 2): a renamed or moved rule, and a moved or newly identified resource. No value is a key of the same map.

rules.description: New `tool|ruleId` of a rule, keyed by its former `tool|ruleId`.

resources.description: New resource, keyed by the former resource: `path:<path>` or `id:<identifier>`.

command.description: Argument vector of the command that writes one SARIF log, run without a shell in the root.

log.description: Path of the SARIF log written by the command; unique among the checks, and distinct from the output.

exit_codes.description: Exit statuses meaning that the command ran to completion.

block.description: Levels that block for the results of this check, in place of the default of the policy.

scope.description: `root` when the command always checks the whole root; `paths` when it accepts paths appended to its argument vector, so that a scoped run checks only those paths (version 2).
